description: One tool for the reviewed release plan in .tapp/release-plan.json. action: `read` (default) · `review` (approve/reject/defer items — decision metadata only) · `generate` (grounded Task/contract DRAFTS under .tapp/proposals; untrusted, no AI) · `validate` (replay drafts on a real target) · `promote` (move fully validated drafts into reviewed artifacts) · `pr` (deterministic PR coverage plan from changedFiles) · `adopt` (append one observed PR coverage proposal) · `actor_read` / `actor_set` (named test actors; env-var NAMES only, never credential values). Nothing is trusted until real deterministic replay passes and promotion is explicit.

androidAppId.description: Android: application id on a connected emulator/device

apkPath.description: Android: optional APK to install first

appBundleId.description: iOS: bundle id of the installed app

changedFiles.description: pr: repository-relative changed paths or provider change objects

item.description: adopt: exploration target id to append

prPlanPath.description: adopt: executed PR plan with conclusive exploration evidence

projectDir.description: Repo-relative project root; defaults to the MCP workspace root

replace.description: actor_set: replace an existing actor's non-secret configuration

name: tapp_plan
title: The release-plan lifecycle
